title: wsl-notice notification
description: Input to send (stdin JSON or --file). Syntactic gate only: the sanitizer, the post-sanitizing empty-message check and the link scheme exit codes are applied by the tool.

title.description: One line (newlines become spaces); at most 100000 characters of input (else exit 20 invalid_payload); cut to max_title characters at render time.

message.description: At most 100000 characters of input (else exit 20 invalid_payload); must not be empty after sanitizing (exit 20 empty_message).

link.description: http or https URL, no whitespace or control characters, no userinfo.
